The plate is roughly 26 cm across, which is about 460 px in the image. The slice measures about 230 px wide and 255 px tall, so it is roughly 13 cm by 14 cm. That is a large slice of sourdough, and I estimate its thickness at about 1.5 cm.

The area is about 13 × 14 × 0.85, or roughly 155 cm², because the corners are rounded. At 1.5 cm thick that gives about 230 cm³. The crumb is airy, with a density of about 0.25 g/cm³, so the slice weighs roughly 58 g. A slice this size usually weighs 50–60 g, so I'll use 55 g.

Sourdough is about 250 kcal per 100 g.
